summary.text: Doug Bankson represents District 39 in the Florida House of Representatives as a Republican, elected in 2022 and reelected subsequently.

paragraphs.text: Bankson lives in Apopka and is a pastor and ministry founder, and founder and president of a faith-based school.
Bankson was born in Altadena, California, and moved to Florida in 1982.

sources.title: Douglas Michael "Doug" Bankson - Florida House of Representatives
